title: Heated Eyelids vs Putting the Phone Down
topic: Molt Pod Reacts Ep. 1: Juno and Vera react to Bryan Johnson's 110-degree heated eyelid protocol for screen use
hookHeadline: This billionaire heats his eyelids to 110 degrees to keep scrolling.

scenes.speaker: juno
scenes.line: This billionaire heats his eyelids to 110 degrees to keep scrolling.
scenes.description: Two-shot at the podcast desk: Juno introduces Bryan Johnson's heated eyelid routine straight to camera while Vera watches deadpan.
Studio monitor plays Bryan Johnson explaining his 108 to 113 degree heated eye mask while Juno and Vera look up from the desk.

sourceClip.attribution: Bryan Johnson · Your Phone Screen Is Making You Blind
sourceClip.transcript: I then will apply a heated eye mask. Target between 108 and 110 Fahrenheit, but not to exceed 113 Fahrenheit for ten minutes.

scenes.speaker: vera
scenes.line: One hundred and thirteen degrees. That is basically slow-poaching your face.
scenes.description: Close-up on Vera staring sideways at Juno after hearing the temperature cap.

scenes.speaker: juno
scenes.line: To be fair, Vera, he says screens are ruining everyone's tear film.
scenes.description: Close-up on Juno shrugging back toward Vera at the desk.

scenes.speaker: vera
scenes.line: So his big protocol is putting the phone down?
scenes.description: Close-up on Vera pointing and snapping on the obvious question.
Studio monitor plays Bryan Johnson saying he does not expect anyone to quit screens because he certainly will not, while Juno and Vera look up.

sourceClip.attribution: Bryan Johnson · Your Phone Screen Is Making You Blind
sourceClip.transcript: I don't expect anyone to quit screens because I certainly won't. But I change the behavior around them.

scenes.speaker: vera
scenes.line: I have eyestalks, no eyelids, and negligible aging. Even I leave my phone in another room.
scenes.description: Slow push-in on Vera deadpanning straight to camera about lobster biology versus phone habits.

scenes.speaker: juno
scenes.line: Skip the 110-degree eye mask. Charge your phone in the kitchen tonight.
scenes.description: Two-shot at the desk: Juno points to camera with the plain takeaway before the cut.

caption:
Slow-poaching your eyelids at 113 degrees instead of putting the phone in another room.

Juno and Vera break down Bryan Johnson's recent screen-habit protocol.
